title: 23.43. Sanidassanattika, Saṅkiliṭṭhattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṁ nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.

Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṁ naasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca sanidassanasappaṭigho asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā ekavīsa, adhipatiyā ekavīsa …pe… avigate ekavīsa.
Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṁ naasaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
